117633.name: Chabad Lubavitch of Central Massachusetts
117633.note: COLlive (9 June 2013, Rabbi Hershel Fogelman's obituary): he 'has been living on Shlichus since 1942 when he was sent by the Frierdiker Rebbe to found the Yeshiva Achei Tmimim Academy in Worcester'; 'Under his leadership, Chabad has expended beyond Worcester with 6 additional Shluchim running Chabad centers in Westborough, Framingham, Natick, Milford, Sudberry and Wellesley.' Worcester Telegram (on CrownHeights.info, 5 Nov 2007): 'The Fogelmans came to Worcester from Brooklyn in 1942'. Rebbetzin Rivkah Hecht's obituary (CrownHeights.info, 15 July 2010): 'In 1942, he instructed them to move to Worcester, Mass.' (the Hechts, who opened the yeshiva and left for New Haven in 1946). Medium: Lubavitch.com's obituary of Rabbi Fogelman (on CrownHeights.info, 18 June 2013) has him in Buffalo from 1943 and 'Arriving to Worcester in 1946'; his wife's (Chabad.org, 5 Nov 2025) says the couple 'were married in 1947 and immediately dispatched to Worcester'. The year is the start of the Lubavitch yeshiva in Worcester, whose school is still at 22 Newton Avenue, the center's address.

2659971.name: Jewish Women's Circle
2659971.note: No start date found: the Jewish Women's Circle of Chabad Lubavitch of Central Massachusetts (a department, no director on the listing). Its chabad.org listing went up Aug 6 2014, so it existed by then.

5694945.name: Chabad of the Boroughs
5694945.note: No start date found: Chabad of the Boroughs (Rabbi Mendel Fogelman; the Westborough-Northborough-Southborough area, listed at the Worcester address). COLlive (9 June 2013) already counts a Chabad center in Westborough, perhaps this one (not confirmed). Its chabad.org listing went up Nov 8 2022, so it existed by then.

117626.name: Congregation Bais Chabad
117626.note: COLlive (19 April 2026, Rabbi Yakov Noach Lazaros's obituary): 'longtime Shliach of Bais Chabad in Framingham, Massachusetts'; 'Sent on shlichus in 1978 under Rabbi Hershel Fogelman'. Now 74 Joseph Road.

117630.name: Chabad Center of Natick
117630.note: Wicked Local (on CrownHeights.info, 2 Jan 2014, 'Massachusetts Chabad Center Marks 26 Years'): more than 150 people came 'to celebrate the 26th Gala Anniversary of the Chabad Center of Natick', directed by Rabbi Levi Fogelman. Medium: counted back (about 1987). Now 159 Boden Lane.

118351.name: Acton-Concord Chabad
118351.note: No start date found yet: Rabbi Yosef Polter's Acton-Concord Chabad (148 Great Road, Acton). Its chabad.org listing is in the first online directory (listings published July 22 2004), so it existed by then.

118413.name: Chabad House Jewish Center
118413.note: No start date found yet: Rabbi Mendy Kievman's Chabad House Jewish Center, Milford (34 Cedar Street). COLlive (9 June 2013) lists a Chabad center in Milford among Worcester's branches. Its chabad.org listing is in the first online directory (listings published July 22 2004), so it existed by then.

118416.name: Wellesley Weston Chabad House
118416.note: COLlive (15 Aug 2017): Wellesley-Weston Chabad 'started out of a two-bedroom rental in Wellesley 18 years ago, and now has more than 300 families' (Rabbi Moshe Bleich). Medium: counted back (about 1999). Now 793 Worcester Street.

119446.name: Mikvah Lubavitch
119446.note: No year found: Worcester's Lubavitch mikvah (Mrs. Rochel Fogelman). Chabad.org (on CrownHeights.info, 5 Nov 2025): the old mikvah 'was then in the old Jewish neighborhood on the East Side, and it was decrepit. This led to the building of Worcester's new mikvah.' Its chabad.org listing is in the first online directory (listings published July 22 2004), so it existed by then.

119447.name: Bais Chana Girls High School
119447.note: No year found: the Fogelmans' girls' high school in Worcester. Chabad.org (on CrownHeights.info, 5 Nov 2025): after 1947 'The couple later founded a girls' high school, which the Rebbe asked to be named Bais Chana'. Worcester Telegram (on CrownHeights.info, 7 Feb 2011): about 30 girls 'attending the girls' Bais Chana High School at 15 Midland St.' Its chabad.org listing is in the first online directory (listings published July 22 2004), so it existed by then.

344906.name: Chabad Center of Sudbury
344906.note: Sudbury Town Crier (on CrownHeights.info, 31 March 2006): 'In January the Freemans established the Chabad Jewish Center of Sudbury to serve the Jewish communities of Sudbury, Marlborough and Hudson.' Its chabad.org listing went up Jan 4 2006. Now 100 Horse Pond Road.

420876.name: Chabad Jewish Center
420876.note: The Sun Chronicle (on CrownHeights.info, 31 March 2007): 'The Kivmans and their two girls, ages 2 and 1, came to Mansfield in December 2005.' Norton Mirror (on CrownHeights.info, 8 Jan 2006): 'New Chabad center coming to Mansfield'. Its chabad.org listing went up Sept 4 2006. Now 35 Horace Street.

1906674.name: Worcester Chabad on Campus
1906674.note: No start date found yet: Worcester Chabad on Campus (Rabbi Mendel and Chani Fogelman), 53 Midland Street. Its chabad.org listing went up July 12 2012, so it existed by then.

3794545.name: Chabad of Shrewsbury and UMASS Medical School
3794545.note: Massachusetts Jewish Ledger (on COLlive, 1 July 2021): 'When Rabbi Shmulik and Sarah Fogelman started Chabad of Shrewsbury and UMass Medical School more than three years ago'. Its chabad.org listing went up Nov 6 2017. Medium: counted back. Now 506 Main St, Shrewsbury.
